$comment: Developer Harness V3 (D3.3) pinned infrastructure artifacts. Every artifact is fetched from its official source over HTTPS and verified against the digest or signature recorded here BEFORE use. A mismatch aborts setup. Changing a pin is a reviewed repository change (root of trust: scripts/developer-harness-v3/**).

msys2_base.purpose: User-scope MSYS2 base (no administrator rights, no driver, no service) used only to obtain the official signed QEMU for Windows package via pacman.
msys2_base.fingerprint_source: https://www.msys2.org/docs/installer/ (signing key of the MSYS2 installer, retrieved 2026-11-24)

debian_image.purpose: Debian 13 (trixie) genericcloud amd64 base disk for the worker VM; used read-only as a qcow2 backing file.
debian_image.digest_source: https://cloud.debian.org/images/cloud/trixie/20261123-2671/SHA512SUMS (HTTPS; Debian publishes no detached signature for cloud images)

claude_linux_x64.purpose: Official Claude Code native Linux binary, installed root-owned and read-only inside the worker. Fetched by the host, never by the worker.
claude_linux_x64.digest_source: npm registry dist.integrity for @anthropic-ai/claude-code-linux-x64@2.1.331 (matches the version of the host's official CLI)

qemu_version_note: MSYS2 serves only the latest package, so the version cannot be selected at install time; setup REFUSES any other installed version (SETUP.QEMU_VERSION_DRIFT). Updating QEMU = a reviewed change of this pin plus a re-run of the isolation suite.
